title: OX White-label Brand Config
description: A tenant brand for the OX design system. Feed to OXBrand.apply() or mirror as a [data-ox-brand] scope in tokens/whitelabel.css. White-label changes the one accent, grounds, type, and mark — it never changes the structure (square, flat, ruled, one accent).

slug.description: URL-safe tenant id; also written to data-ox-brand.

name.description: Display brand name (the wordmark string). The mark is type.

mark.description: Override the wordmark string if it differs from name (e.g. an abbreviation).

accent.description: The ONE chromatic accent. A tenant gets exactly one — used the OX way (≤10% of any surface).

accentDeep.description: Hover/press step (~12% darker). Derived from accent if omitted.

accentBright.description: Accent on dark ground. Derived from accent if omitted.

ground.description: Page ground. Keep warm/near-mono; never pure #FFF.

fontMono.description: CSS font-family stack for labels + the mark.

mode.description: Default color mode for the tenant (written to data-ox-mode).

logo.description: Optional raster/SVG logo URL. The OX mark is type by default; supply only if the tenant requires a custom glyph.
